title: Office Impact Summit
summary: A full day for office, workplace and facilities professionals: keynotes, roundtables, wellbeing moments and peer connection.
body:
The first Office Impact Summit was created for the people who run the workplace and shape how it feels. The programme combined practical roundtables, keynote sessions and time to connect with peers.

This is a real past event included to demonstrate how the site keeps an event archive automatically once the date has passed.

title: Community coffee: what brings people back to the office?
summary: A small peer session on attendance, energy and creating an office people actually want to use.
